title: That's Not Nice (3)
subtitle: Idioms for annoying people and secrets, plus a review of the week.

idioms.ex: My neighbour's loud music every night **drives me up a wall**.

idioms.mean: tell a secret too early or by mistake
idioms.ex: We planned a surprise party, but my little brother **spilled the beans**.

tip: **spill the beans** juga dipakai untuk minta cerita: *Come on, spill the beans!* (ayo, ceritain!). **drive someone up a wall** mirip dengan *drive someone crazy*.

options: drive a car up a hill
make a mess in the kitchen
keep someone waiting with false promises

dialogue.q: A: Why do you look so angry? B: My little sister keeps taking my clothes without asking. It ___!
dialogue.why: Sangat kesal → drives me up a wall.

dialogue.q: A: Who told Dina about the surprise party? B: Sorry, I ___. I thought she already knew!
A: He told me he was stuck in traffic, but I saw him at the mall! B: He ___.
dialogue.why: Review: alasan palsu → fed you a line.

dialogue.q: A: My friend promised to drive me to the airport, then just didn't come. He ___. B: That's terrible!
dialogue.why: Review: ditinggal tanpa bantuan → left me high and dry.

correct.q: "I can't tell you the ending of the film. I don't want to spill the beans."
"This quiet, peaceful café really drives me up a wall."
correct.why: Salah: tempat tenang dan nyaman tidak bikin kesal.

correct.q: "I spilled the beans on my shirt, so everyone knows the secret."
correct.why: Salah: idiom ini tentang rahasia, bukan menumpahkan kacang ke baju.

correct.q: "The ad promising free iPhones was a snow job."

speak.q: What drives you up a wall?
speak.model: People who chew loudly <mark>drive me up a wall</mark>. Slow Wi-Fi during an online meeting also <mark>drives me up a wall</mark>.
speak.label: drive someone up a wall

speak.q: Have you ever spilled the beans by accident?
speak.model: Yes, I once <mark>spilled the beans</mark> about my friend's birthday surprise. I said "see you at the party!" in front of her. Everyone was so angry with me!
speak.label: spill the beans

speak.q: Tell a short story with two idioms from this week.
speak.model: My friend promised to help me move house, but on the day he <mark>fed me a line</mark> about being sick. He <mark>left me high and dry</mark>, and I had to carry everything alone.
speak.label: idiom from this week

roleplay.situation: Ada yang membocorkan rencana kejutan ulang tahun untuk dosen/atasan kalian.
steps: **Student A:** marah karena rencana kejutannya bocor (*Someone spilled the beans!*).
**Student B:** bilang orang yang membocorkan itu memang selalu bikin kesal (*He drives me up a wall*).
**Student A:** curiga orang itu bohong saat ditanya (*He fed us a line*).
**Both:** pakai minimal 2 idiom lain dari minggu ini (string along, snow job, sell down the river, high and dry, sell short), lalu buat rencana baru.
roleplay.target: Target: percakapan 2 menit, minimal 5 idiom minggu ini terpakai.
